idea: route parse-attachment and sense decisions through whole-text semantic topography
mechanism: semanticTopographicSimilarity answers 'noun' 3 times in 4 against a balanced set, so it is a class-biased constant; always guessing noun scores the same 8/16
evidence: 8/16 = 50% on 16 PP-attachment minimal pairs, chance 50%. Largest margin in the set is a WRONG answer (brush 0.314 beats telescope 0.277)
unbindsIf: a per-class breakdown clears chance on BOTH attachment classes, not just the aggregate

idea: wire npAnchor (read the full-span NP head out of chart.spanning) into the constellation page as the nominal anchor
mechanism: on 809 held-out short NPs with the live lexicon, npAnchor scores 0.7874 while the one-line rule 'last token tagged n' scores 0.8616; McNemar lastNoun-wins 89 vs npAnchor-wins 29, chi2cc 29.5. It also fails to separate from the SHIPPED phrase layer (0.7676): npAnchor-wins 84 vs A-wins 68, chi2cc 1.48, p~0.22. A projection that loses to one line of code and ties what already ships is not a seam.
evidence: docs/superpowers/evidence/2026-08-19-seam-2-np-anchor.json (checksum 24f1bb7708aadf71); prereg docs/superpowers/evidence/2026-08-19-PREREG-seam-2-np-anchor.md declared F1 'must beat lastTaggedNoun' before execution
